correctness.rationale: Direct rational composition gives f^2(X)-X=(2X^2+1)/(X(X^2+1)) and f^3(X)-X=P3/[X(X^2+1)(X^4+3X^2+1)] with P3=3X^6+9X^4+6X^2+1. Independently recomputed resultant(P3,denominator)=1 over Z, preventing spurious solutions in every characteristic. Fixed points do not exist. The 2-cycle condition is solvability of X^2=-1/2 in odd characteristic. Over p>3 the six roots x_a=(zeta_9^a-zeta_9^-a)^-1 are distinct, have f(x_a)=x_(-2a), and Frobenius x_a->x_(qa); they lie in F_q exactly when q=1 mod9. In p=3 P3=1; in p=2 P3=(X^3+X^2+1)^2, giving one three-cycle when 3|r. All boundaries and poles are excluded explicitly.
